sections.heading: A proper local barber shop
body: Marlowe's opened on Market Street with two chairs and one rule: nobody leaves until they are happy with their haircut.
We have grown since then, but the rule has not changed. Whether you want a tidy-up before work or a full restyle, you will get our full attention and an honest opinion.

items.a: No. Walk-ins are welcome all day. If you are short on time, call ahead and we will hold a chair.
Yes, card, contactless and cash are all fine.
There is free parking for one hour on Market Street and a pay and display car park behind the shop.

sections.heading: Find us
sections.text: We are on Market Street, two doors down from the post office.
